goal: Repair CGKN generation recovery in causal order by unifying resume identity, stabilizing semantic hashes, aligning canonical planning ownership and leaf dependencies, and improving model routing plus failure classification.
acceptance_criteria: A pending automatically expanded leaf resumes when its exact saved manifest, target entry, component contract, and leaf graph remain compatible with the frozen plan; a truly stale named-package manifest is still rejected.
Repeated design research with identical semantic inputs yields the same component specification identity even when artifact timestamps differ.
A passing GoalDrivenProjectPlan is the path authority for every goal-derived component, preventing complexity enrichment from adding a duplicate backend architecture beside canonical app/src outputs.

Automatically expanded sibling leaves do not depend on one another merely because of split order, and dependency normalization runs on the expanded manifest so each leaf receives its actual shared providers.
Component-file generation uses a capability-appropriate Provider model instead of being downgraded solely because one leaf payload is small.
Remote disconnect and equivalent connection-closure failures classify as provider transport, while current identity-bound pending work is not made unsafe by superseded historical hashes.
Ordinary prose such as symbol contracts cannot create a required code symbol; only the exact required code symbol wording can do so.
No fix writes a sealed generated candidate, adds a generation path, changes the Telegram default route, packages output, or promotes support evidence to formal PASS.
Targeted resume, design, goal-plan, dependency, routing, plugin, kernel, and management regressions pass.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: canonical goal behaviors mapped to substantive executable tests and a real passing post-build test run
quality_metrics.target: every canonical test intent has one exact non-trivial test symbol and the post-build goal-acceptance receipt is PASS before review readiness
quality_metrics.method: deterministic plan-identity inspection, Python test AST inspection, post-build test-result binding, and negative missing/trivial/failed-test cases

quality_metrics.measure: bounded Codex escalation usefulness and authority isolation
quality_metrics.target: a librarian-curated request and Codex response stay within configured budgets, preserve request identity, produce actionable guidance, and cannot assert formal evidence or delivery authority
quality_metrics.method: schema validation, deterministic contract tests, support-pipeline prompt tests, and an offline failed-generation replay

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: pending_repair_plan.json carries one bounded resume_identity shared by runtime validation and MCP diagnosis.
Provider component specification identity consumes a stable design semantic hash while the full timestamped research manifest remains available for traceability.
GoalDrivenProjectPlan expected outputs remain canonical component paths and are not duplicated by an inherited fixed backend architecture.
Expanded leaf dependency allowlists contain only declared implemented providers and never infer sibling sequencing as an API dependency.
MCP failure diagnosis separates current resume identity from historical superseded attempts and preserves formal evidence NOT_EVALUATED.

feedback: Accepted: causal identity, planning ownership, dependency, routing, and MCP diagnosis relationships are covered without changing delivery authority.

worked: One identity contract shared by runtime and diagnosis made resume behavior testable and explainable.
did_not_work: Timestamp hashes, coarse required-path checks, and split-order dependencies each encoded incidental execution detail as if it were semantic authority.
experiments: For the next Provider interruption, compare the reported resume_identity fields with the pending leaf before permitting regeneration.
